description: This file defines the User entity class in a Java application, mapping to a 'users' table in a database, with attributes such as username, passwordHash, fullName, enabled, and roles. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Entity class representing a user with credentials, full name, status, and roles, extending BaseEntity for common entity features.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username of the user.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Returns the hashed password of the user.

methods.name: setPasswordHash
methods.description: Sets the hashed password of the user.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the user.

methods.name: setFullName
methods.description: Sets the full name of the user.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the user account is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status of the user account.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of roles associated with the user.

methods.name: setRoles
methods.description: Sets the roles associated with the user.
